affected_party: QIF maintainers, non-expert operators, AI agents, and organizations trying to discover quality intent
actual_problem: QIF v0.2.1 can represent discovered quality intents, but it does not yet guide non-experts through discovering what stakeholders consider failure, unacceptable risk, or necessary outcomes.
why_it_matters: Without a discovery layer, users may either fail to produce useful quality intents or fall back to fixed quality checklists, which is an explicit QIF anti-pattern.
why_now: QIF v0.2.1 has a stable representation/runtime baseline and the next major gap is upstream discovery before QIF generation.
evidence_refs: user-provided QIF Discovery Layer Design Note
